admission.justification: Two different claims are now kept apart: no counter and no per-agent, task, master or workspace token figure replaces the removed cost view, and AR reads the host's usage report in one place for the limit only. The preserved absence claims are held by the dashboard absence tests (master reader, cockpit) and the no-usage-figure rules; the admitted reader is held by its own cases for the report judgement, the file and the hold, so the justification no longer rests on an empty usage-read diff.

applicability: Every limit the product attributes to a role seat, and every read of the host's usage report.
conditions: The report is available, and one of its account-wide windows is exhausted with a reset in the future; a scoped window does not hold a seat.
Enabled extra usage, or a credits balance above zero, releases the seat.
One reader, one file and one answer at a time: the product writes `provider-limits.json` whole and atomically, and every other reader reads that file only.
A read happens only at a new stamped turn end; there is no timer and no periodic read.
exclusions: No token number per agent, task, master or workspace is shown, and no usage figure beyond rule 13's word and hover is displayed.
Chat text, error text and model names produce no limit, and no API key or login store is read.

evidence: git diff --stat (those paths absent); dashboard Chats-view picture shows no usage line

statement: AR reads the host's usage report in one place and for the limit only: a report holds work solely on an exhausted account-wide window, and an enabled extra usage or a positive credits balance releases it.
